messages.body: Hi Rohan, I saw you're open to mentoring. Which electives did you take in third year?
Hey! I took NLP and Computer Vision. CV had a great lab component.
Honestly in first year just focus on DSA and Python. Electives can wait.
Good afternoon sir, I'm a first-year AIML student. Could I meet you to ask about joining a research project?
Sure. Come to Block A, Room 304 on Wednesday between 2 and 4. Bring a short list of topics you find interesting.
Hi, how do I join GDGC?
Just tap Join on the GDGC community page. Then come to the next study jam!
Hey, are you going to the photo walk?
